title: Build Array Where You Can Find The Maximum Exactly K Comparisons
description: Find the number of ways to build an array of length n such that the maximum value is exactly k comparisons.
pseudocode:
1. dp[len][max][cost] = ways to form array
2. for length from 1 to n:
3.   for current_max from 1 to m:
4.     for cost from 1 to k:
5.       dp[len][current_max][cost] += dp[len-1][current_max][cost] * current_max
6.       dp[len][current_max][cost] += sum(dp[len-1][prev_max][cost-1]) where prev_max < current_max
